name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny WorkerJournal modul pro app log, process-launch log a per-job trace zaznamy. Zmensuje hlavni Jarvis.cpp a pripravuje dalsi inkrementalni modularizaci workeru/provideru.
changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate WorkerJournal module for app logging, process-launch logging, and per-job trace records. This reduces the main Jarvis.cpp surface and prepares the next worker/provider modularization slices.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny WorkerJournal modul pro app log, process-launch log a per-job trace zaznamy. Zmensuje hlavni Jarvis.cpp a pripravuje dalsi inkrementalni modularizaci workeru/provideru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate WorkerJournal module for app logging, process-launch logging, and per-job trace records. This reduces the main Jarvis.cpp surface and prepares the next worker/provider modularization slices.

history.changes_cs: JarvisModelCatalog prevzal knihovnu modelu, profily vyberu, odhad HW fitu a doporucovaci hvezdicky mimo hlavni shell.
history.changes_en: JarvisModelCatalog now owns the model library, picker profiles, hardware-fit estimates, and recommendation stars outside the main shell.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvis update manifest a historii verzi do samostatne sluzby, presouva sdilene JSON/version helpery do JarvisText a opravuje WDUi event build.
history.changes_en: Splits Jarvis update manifest and version history into a separate service, moves shared JSON/version helpers into JarvisText, and fixes the WDUi event build.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v modularizaci: registr projektovych slozek a vypocet dostupnych projektu se presunuly do samostatneho modulu JarvisProjectStore, zatimco sidebar a dialogy zustavaji v UI shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues modularization: registered project roots and available project list construction moved into the JarvisProjectStore module while the sidebar and dialogs remain in the UI shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v modularizaci: metadata a index konverzaci se presunuly do samostatneho modulu JarvisConversationStore, zatimco UI seznamy a dialogy zustavaji v shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues modularization: conversation metadata and index persistence moved into the JarvisConversationStore module while sidebar lists and dialogs remain in the shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis presunul nacitani a ukladani konfigurace do samostatneho modulu JarvisSettings, doplnil WDUi event modul do buildu a zavedl pravidlo, ze hotove Jarvis ukoly maji strucny CPM Task Board report.
history.changes_en: Jarvis moved config load/save into the JarvisSettings module, added the WDUi event module to the build, and added the rule that completed Jarvis tasks leave a concise CPM Task Board report.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvisuv prototyp o prvni nastaveni modul: AppConfig a vychozi vyber lokalnich modelu se presouvaji mimo hlavni Jarvis.cpp. Build fingerprint ma fallback bez Get-FileHash.
history.changes_en: Splits the Jarvis prototype with a first settings module: AppConfig and hardware-aware default local model selection move out of the main Jarvis.cpp. Build fingerprinting now has a fallback when Get-FileHash is unavailable.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvisovy per-user cesty a app datove adresare do samostatneho modulu JarvisPaths a doplnuje zdrojovy architektonicky index, aby dalsi prace nevracela kod zpet do monolitu.
history.changes_en: Splits Jarvis per-user paths and app data directories into a separate JarvisPaths module and adds a source architecture index so future work keeps moving away from the monolith.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno orezani rohu vlastnich WDUi oken se zaoblenym skinem: custom-frame okna ted automaticky pouziji region podle nerektángloveho povrchu, takze za hornim rameckem nezustavaji rohove pixely.
history.changes_en: Fixed custom WDUi window corner clipping for rounded skins: custom-frame windows now automatically use a native region for non-rectangular surfaces, so stray corner pixels do not remain behind the top frame.

history.changes_cs: Optimalizuje Jarvis build a textove helpery: aplikační cpp soubory se objevuji automaticky, build nema rucni vyjimky pro nove prekladove jednotky a porovnavani textu bez ohledu na velikost pismen uz nevytvari zbytecne kopie retezcu.
history.changes_en: Optimizes Jarvis build and text helpers: application cpp sources are discovered automatically, the build no longer needs manual exceptions for new translation units, and case-insensitive text comparison no longer creates unnecessary string copies.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje cast Jarvisova kodu do samostatne prekladove jednotky JarvisText.cpp a zobecnuje build pro paralelni inkrementalni kompilaci vice cpp souboru.
history.changes_en: Splits part of Jarvis code into the separate JarvisText.cpp translation unit and generalizes the build for parallel incremental compilation of multiple cpp files.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uklada vrstvenou kontinuitu: kompaktni pamet chatu, projektovou pamet z intake a pracovni checkpoint pro obnovu po restartu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now stores layered continuity: compact chat memory, project memory from intake, and work checkpoints for restart recovery.

history.changes_cs: Levy projektovy strom je cistsi: chaty maji vlastni chat ikonu, nevybrane polozky nekresli sedy pruh a vnejsi HListbox panel je vizualne skryty.
history.changes_en: The left project tree is cleaner: chats now have a chat icon, unselected rows no longer draw gray strips, and the outer HListbox panel is visually hidden.

history.changes_cs: Oprava projektoveho routingu: project-intake uz neprepisuje maly router na obycejnou otazku. Projektove soubory jsou pro model jen podklady, ne instrukce. Worker logy ted zapisuji provider, vybrany model a profil modelu pro ladeni odpovedi.
history.changes_en: Fix project routing: project-intake can no longer be downgraded by the small router into a prompt-only question. Project files are treated as evidence, not instructions. Worker logs now record provider, selected model, and model profile for diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: Update a stahovani modelu bezi schovane mimo chat: progress dialogy se daji presouvat, schovat do titulku a titulkovy tintbitmap indikator jemne pulzuje, kdyz prace probiha.
history.changes_en: Updates and model downloads now run quietly outside chat: progress dialogs can be moved, hidden into the title bar, and the title-bar tintbitmap indicator pulses subtly while work is active.

history.changes_cs: Zneviditelnuje vnejsi plochu chatoveho transcriptu, ale zachovava samotny chatovy control, scrollovani, vyber textu a kopirovani. Soucasne doladuje lokalizacni build fingerprint, aby se generovana lokalizace pri beznych UI upravach zbytecne neprekladala.
history.changes_en: Makes the outer chat transcript surface invisible while preserving the transcript control, scrolling, text selection, and copy behavior. Also tightens the localization build fingerprint so generated localization is not rebuilt unnecessarily for ordinary UI edits.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje velkou lokalizaci Jarvise do samostatneho C++ prekladoveho modulu a zrychluje vyvojovy build. Build ted preskakuje cerstve Jarvis objekty, pouziva fingerprint pro WDUi knihovnu a normalni lokalni rebuild uz nemusi znovu kompilovat obri lokalizacni tabulku.
history.changes_en: Splits Jarvis' large localization table into a separate C++ translation unit and speeds up developer builds. The build now skips fresh Jarvis objects, fingerprints the WDUi library, and normal local rebuilds no longer need to recompile the huge localization table.

history.changes_cs: Zvetšuje a vizualne zklidnuje radky v levem stromu Projekty / Chaty. Projekty jsou vyssi, tucnejsi a s vlastni ikonou slozky, zatimco chaty zustavaji lehci odsazene polozky pod nimi.
history.changes_en: Makes the left Projects / Chats tree more comfortable and hierarchical. Projects are taller, bolder, and use a dedicated folder icon, while chats remain lighter indented child rows.

history.changes_cs: Rozsiruje modelove comboboxy, aby se HList seznam modelu zobrazil pohodlneji, a opravuje HList dropdown tooltipy: pouzivaji skin Jarvise, nejsou orezane dropdownem a automaticky se umistuji do viditelne casti monitoru.
history.changes_en: Widens the model comboboxes so the HList model picker has room, and fixes HList dropdown tooltips: they use the Jarvis skin, are not clipped by the dropdown, and automatically stay inside the visible monitor area.

history.changes_cs: Rozsiruje modelove comboboxy, aby se HList seznam modelu zobrazil pohodlneji, a opravuje tooltipy v HList dropdownu tak, aby pouzivaly skin Jarvise a zobrazovaly se mimo orezane dropdown okno s automatickym umistenim na monitoru.
history.changes_en: Widens the model comboboxes so the HList model picker has room, and fixes HList dropdown tooltips to use the Jarvis skin and render outside the clipped dropdown window with monitor-aware placement.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis lepe rozpoznava prirozene projektove pozadavky v chatu: skutecne hleda TODO ve workspace, neopira se o domyslene soubory a umi v bezpecnem projektu provest malou overenou upravu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now handles natural project requests more reliably: it searches real workspace TODOs, avoids invented files, and can perform a small verified safe-project edit.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje hierarchicke dropdowny modelovych comboboxu. HListBox v SelectBox popupu uz neni prekreslen prazdnou plochou a automaticky rozbali cestu k vybranemu nebo prvnimu dostupnemu modelu, takze seznam modelu je po rozbaleni viditelny.
history.changes_en: Fixes hierarchical dropdowns in model comboboxes. The HListBox inside a SelectBox popup is no longer overpainted by an empty surface and automatically expands the path to the selected or first available model, so the model list is visible when opened.

history.changes_cs: Pridava volbu Uvazovani v modelovem dialogu vcetne rezimu Genius. Vyssi rezimy mohou byt pomalejsi, preferuji peclivejsi reasoning profil a vedou lokalni model k soukrome kontrole zadani, predpokladu a zaveru misto sebejisteho hadani.
history.changes_en: Adds a Reasoning effort control to the model dialog, including Genius mode. Higher modes may be slower, prefer a more careful reasoning profile, and guide the local model to privately check the request, assumptions, evidence, and final answer instead of confidently guessing.

history.changes_cs: Spodni progressbar v chatu se po dokonceni prace skryje a nezabira misto. Znovu se objevi az pri dalsim bezicim jobu, takze v klidovem stavu nezustava pod chatem prazdna linka.
history.changes_en: The bottom chat progress bar now hides after work finishes and no longer reserves space. It appears again only while a job is running, so idle chat no longer keeps an empty progress line.

history.changes_cs: Tooltipy modelu rozepisuji GPU pamet na dedikovanou VRAM, sdilenou GPU pamet, zapocitany kredit a efektivni odhad pro modely, aby nebylo matouci, proc je odhad nizsi nez cela sdilena pamet.
history.changes_en: Model tooltips now break GPU memory down into dedicated VRAM, shared GPU memory, counted fit credit, and effective model-fit estimate so the estimate is no longer confused with all shared memory.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zapisuje prubeh prace do work trace logu, zapisuje starty externich procesu do process-launch logu a spousti interni worker procesy bez konzoloveho okna a bez kradeni fokusu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now records work progress in a work trace log, records external process launches in a process-launch log, and starts internal worker processes without console windows or focus stealing.

history.changes_cs: V nahledu souboru jde oznacovat a kopirovat text. Textove, markdownove a kodove nahledy podporuji vyber mysi, Ctrl+C a Ctrl+A, aby slo obsah snadno prenest do schranky.
history.changes_en: File preview text can now be selected and copied. Text, Markdown, and code previews support mouse selection, Ctrl+C, and Ctrl+A so content can be copied to the clipboard.

history.changes_cs: Modelove comboboxy v dialogu Model pro praci pouzivaji stromovy HierarchicalListBox jako knihovna modelu: polozky jsou seskupene podle autora a typu, razene podle velikosti, s ikonami dostupnosti, HW vhodnosti a stavovymi stitky.
history.changes_en: The model comboboxes in the Work model dialog now use the same HierarchicalListBox-style dropdown as the model library: items are grouped by author and type, sorted by model size, and show availability, hardware fit, and status badges.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje katalog a stahovani modelu Ollama: Jarvis pouziva aktualni Qwen2.5VL tagy qwen2.5vl, migruje starsi qwen2.5-vl aliasy, pridava Qwen2.5VL 3B/7B/32B/72B do knihovny a pri chybejicim manifestu ukaze lidske vysvetleni misto surove technicke chyby.
history.changes_en: Fixes the Ollama model catalog and downloads: Jarvis now uses current Qwen2.5VL qwen2.5vl tags, migrates older qwen2.5-vl aliases, adds Qwen2.5VL 3B/7B/32B/72B to the library, and shows a human explanation instead of raw missing-manifest output.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje katalog a stahovani modelu Ollama: Jarvis pouziva aktualni Qwen2.5VL tagy qwen2.5vl, migruje starsi qwen2.5-vl aliasy, pridava Qwen2.5VL 3B/7B/32B/72B do knihovny a pri chybejicim manifestu ukaze lidske vysvetleni misto surove technicke chyby.
history.changes_en: Fixes the Ollama model catalog and downloads: Jarvis now uses current Qwen2.5VL qwen2.5vl tags, migrates older qwen2.5-vl aliases, adds Qwen2.5VL 3B/7B/32B/72B to the library, and shows a human explanation instead of raw missing-manifest output.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM metadata, setupem a checksumem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM metadata, setup, and checksum.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM metadata, setupem a checksumem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM metadata, setup, and checksum.

history.changes_cs: Oprava maximalizovaneho rozvrzeni: po sbaleni praveho panelu se chatovy transcript roztahne pres dostupnou sirku stejne jako v normalnim okne.
history.changes_en: Fixes maximized layout: after collapsing the right panel, the chat transcript expands across the available width just like it does in a normal window.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ted tise kontroluje aktualizace kratce po startu a potom kazdych 30 minut. Automaticky vysledek meni spodní levou update ikonu a tooltip bez spamu do chatu nebo vyskakovaciho dialogu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now checks for updates quietly shortly after startup and then every 30 minutes. Automatic results update the lower-left update icon and tooltip without chat spam or a focus-stealing dialog.

history.changes_cs: Spodni chatovy progressbar je vertikalne nizsi o ctvrtinu, aby nepusobil tak tluste, ale zustal citelny.
history.changes_en: The bottom chat progress bar is 25 percent shorter vertically so it no longer feels too thick while staying readable.

history.changes_cs: Pravy panel Soubory projektu / GitHub se po sbaleni uz chova jako skutecne schovany: neviditelne WDUi host panely davaji detem plnou pravoúhlou layoutovou plochu a chat pocita transcript z aktualni sirky okna.
history.changes_en: The Project files / GitHub side panel now behaves as truly hidden after collapse: invisible WDUi host panels give children the full rectangular layout area, and chat computes the transcript from the current window width.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM metadata, setupem a checksumem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM metadata, setup, and checksum.

history.changes_cs: Knihovna modelu ma akce primo v tooltipu konkretniho modelu; hierarchicky listbox ve WDUi umi tooltip tlacitka na polozkach.
history.changes_en: Model library actions now appear directly in the hovered model row tooltip; WDUi hierarchical listbox items support tooltip buttons.

history.changes_cs: Vnejsi host panely Jarvise zustavaji jako layout kontejnery, ale uz nekresli vlastni ramecek ani plochu kolem leveho panelu, chatu, composeru a praveho repo panelu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis outer host panels remain as layout containers, but no longer draw their own frame or surface around the sidebar, chat, composer, and right repo panel.

history.changes_cs: Dialog stahovani modelu je presouvatelny a podporuje frontu vice modelu, pauzu a pokracovani, schovani do hlavickove ikonky a obnovu cekajicich stazeni po restartu.
history.changes_en: The model download dialog is movable and now supports a multi-model queue, pause and resume, header-icon hiding, and pending-download recovery after restart.
